title: Farm house norms (agricultural zone)
source: MP Bhumi Vikas Rules 2012, consolidated to 06-03-2025, English PDF

min_plot.row_text: (a) Minimum size of the plot shall be 0.40 hectare;

max_height.row_text: (c) The maximum height of structure shall be 7.5 meters with sloping roof;

live_trees.row_text: (d) Farm House shall have a minimum of 100 live trees per hectare on the plot before the application for building constructions is made to the Authority;

road_access.row_text: (e) Farm House shall be accessible by road having width not less than 7.5 meters;

open_space.row_text: (f) Farm House shall have minimum 7.50 meters open space (MOS) from all sides.
